title: Radiomics models predict occult nodal metastasis in early lung adenocarcinoma
summary: In 1,672 patients with stage cT1a-bN0M0 lung adenocarcinoma from six hospitals, a combined clinical-radiomics model reached an external validation AUC of 0.813 (n=688), above GLM (0.790), SVM (0.761), random forest (0.708) and gradient boosting (0.769) radiomics models. Pooled sensitivity was 75.8-77.2% and specificity 72.0-72.7%. The study is retrospective and the abstract was read only.
ai_technology: Radiomics machine learning models (GLM, SVM, random forest, GBM) and a combined clinical-radiomics model
organization: Ruijin Hospital, Shanghai Jiaotong University School of Medicine; Shanghai Public Health Clinical Center

evidence.tested: Training (n=687), test (n=297) and external validation (n=688) sets against pathology; retrospective.
evidence.unknown: Prospective performance and effect on surgical planning; full text not reviewed.
evidence.ai_role: Predicts nodal metastasis not visible on preoperative staging.

source_review.scope: Abstract read from Europe PMC metadata for this DOI; author affiliations from Europe PMC or Crossref. Full text not accessed.
